name: flow_queue_member_try_waits_for_the_leader
description: A member of a queued party cannot Try (design 5.2, 5.4): the server refuses a member's QUEUE leave and Ready while queued, so a member gone into an offline Try would leave every Match Found the queue makes for the party to run out. On the Builders screen Try is disabled, its tooltip says why, and a Try asked anyway sends nothing and keeps the queue; once the leader takes the party out of the queue, Try plays again.

steps.assert: not node('Try').disabled and node('Try').tooltip_text == 'A solo practice match with this Builder, offline'

steps.msg: Ana, the leader, queues the party

steps.assert: node('Try').disabled and node('Try').tooltip_text == 'The party is in the queue: only the leader can leave it'
steps.msg: queued, a member's Try waits for the leader, and says why
a Try asked anyway plays nothing: still queued, on the Builders screen

steps.assert: Session.last_notice == 'The party is in the queue: only the leader can leave it'

steps.msg: no QUEUE leave and no Not ready went out: the party is in the queue, my Ready kept
out of the queue, Try plays again
